coverage.summary: Covers rental properties with 5 or more units. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. The ordinance has further permitted exemptions, granted on request, but the documents do not detail them.
coverage.other_conditions: Owners may request further exemptions if they meet the ordinance's criteria for a permitted exemption.

result.notes: The coverage is supported by the city page D036 and needs no substantive change; only the summary wording was tightened. min_units=5 is inferred from the statement that all 1-4 unit properties are exempt. The specific Chapter 260 exemption criteria are not in the documents, so they stay unverifiable and requires_unknown_facts=true. The superintendent requirement (buildings with 6 or more units) and the liability insurance requirement on the page are not rent control coverage terms, so they are excluded. Documents DX02, DX04, DX06 and DX11 concern the separate algorithmic rent-fixing ordinance (§218-12) and say nothing about Chapter 260 coverage.
